newsitem.title: USA: CBOT corn futures close lower on stocks reaction.
newsitem.headline: CBOT corn futures close lower on stocks reaction.

text.p: CBOT corn futures closed lower on follow through pressure from Thursday's USDA supply/demand report, traders said.
USDA Thursday said the 1996-97 U.S. ending stocks of corn of corn would be slightly higher than the previous ideas while the government trimmed its outlook for 1996-97 U.S. soybean ending stocks.
Trading was quiet and volume was thin with position squaring before the weekend noted.
Corn closed 1/2 to two cents per bushel lower, with December down 1/2 at $2.67-1/4.

Tenco Inc and Rosenthal Collins each sold three million bushels of March and Iowa Grain sold one million March, traders said. Cargill Inc bought three million bushels of March and Term Commodities bought two million bushels of May, traders said.
Corn futures volume was estimated at 42,000 contracts, below the 51,347 traded Thursday, according to the CBOT.

In corn options, LFG Futures bought 300 March $2.60 puts and sold 300 March $2.70 puts at 5-3/8 cents, Refco Inc bought 300 July $2.50 puts at 6-1/4 cents, Continental Grain bought 300 May $2.70 puts and sold 300 March $2.60 puts at 1-3/4 cents, traders said.
Corn options volume was estimated at 14,000 contracts, below the 19,946 traded Thursday.
